name: Journey: an Outland quest stands at its journey level, not at its reward's authored level
contract: Requires mod-coa-content-scaling with CoAContentScaling.Enable=1, Progression.Mode=Journey, TBC.Enable=1 and WotLK.Enable=1 at the default journey shape (conf/verify-all-scaling.json). In Case of Emergency... (10161) is a Hellfire Peninsula quest of level 61 that opens at 58, started on Outland, open to every race without a quest before it, and rewards a green of required level 60 and item level 87 (25981). On the journey its level follows Outland: Outland(61) = 34 and Outland(58) = 30. Its reward is a journey item too - an Outland green made for level 60, required level Outland(60) = 33 - so the reward does not lift the quest, as mod-world-journey reads the reward after its items are on the journey.

steps.label: The quest stands at its journey level, Outland(61)
A character of the journey's entry level may take it
One level below the journey's entry level may not
